`final class BlendState`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.state` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [BlendState.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/state/BlendState.java)

How a draw combines its colors with the pixels already on the target, an equation and four factors.

## Description

`BlendState` is immutable and compares by value: keep your own blend states in constants, and pass one to `blend(...)` of the [`RenderState`](/reference/pipeline/renderstate/).
The calls of `DrawUtils` set the blending they need; a blend of yours applies to the vertices you send with the [`Tessellator`](/reference/drawing/tessellator/).

## Constant and field details

<a id="BlendState-constant-NORMAL"></a>

### NORMAL

`BlendState NORMAL` 

The usual transparency: the color covers what is under it in proportion to its alpha, and the alpha of the target adds up.
The drawing of JOID uses it for shapes, text and images.

<a id="BlendState-constant-DISABLED"></a>

### DISABLED

`BlendState DISABLED` 

No blending: the color replaces the pixel, alpha included.
It is the blending of a fresh render state.

<a id="BlendState-constant-PREMULTIPLIED"></a>

### PREMULTIPLIED

`BlendState PREMULTIPLIED` 

Blending for colors already multiplied by their alpha, such as the content of a framebuffer drawn over the screen.
